anomalies.observed: The ESP32-C3-MINI-1 (U5) has GPIO6 (pin 11) and GPIO10 (pin 17) both connected to net NET0019, which is the shared SO/MISO line from the three MAX31855 thermocouple amplifiers (U11, U6, U7).
anomalies.expected: The specification states the SPI bus uses SCK on GPIO5 and MISO on GPIO10, with independent chip-selects on GPIO4/GPIO6/GPIO7. GPIO6 should be a dedicated chip-select output, not tied to the shared MISO net.

evidence.quote: SPI2 on GPIO5/GPIO10, CS pins GPIO4/6/7

anomalies.impact: GPIO6 and GPIO10 are shorted together on the MISO net. The firmware cannot independently drive GPIO6 as a chip-select, and any attempt to toggle it will fight the MISO line, corrupting thermocouple reads and potentially damaging the ESP32 pin drivers.

parsed.summary: The schematic shows GPIO6 and GPIO10 of the ESP32 both tied to the shared MAX31855 SO/MISO net (NET0019), which conflicts with the specified SPI pinout where GPIO6 should be an independent chip-select. This bridged net would prevent correct thermocouple polling.
